sourceDocuments.title: Radiative Forcing and Climate Equilibria
sourceDocuments.text: Atmospheric greenhouse gases absorb longwave infrared radiation emitted from the surface of planetary bodies. This trapped thermal energy causes an increase in equilibrium global surface temperatures over extended decadal timescales.
